Name: Gunther's Guide Stardew Valley
Author: visionsmodsaurademais
Description:
[b]Gunther's Guide - In-game Museum Tracker[/b]

Painel dentro do jogo para acompanhar o progresso da coleção do museu (95 itens) sem precisar sair do jogo.

[i]Author: nullrootd[/i]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Progress bar X/95 and next Gunther reward milestone[/*]
[*]Per-item status: Donated, Ready, Found, Missing[/*]
[*]Filters, search, and item IDs (handy with item spawn mods)[/*]
[*]Morning alert when items are ready to donate[/*]
[*]English and Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) localization[/*]
[/list]
By default, acquisition hints are off — the mod focuses on tracking and donating. Enable [i]ShowAcquisitionHints[/i] in config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu for full farming guides.

[b]How to Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*] Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] (required)[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [b]GunthersGuide[/b] folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[b]How to Use[/b]
Press [b]F6[/b] while in-game to open the museum tracker panel.

[b]Configuration[/b]
A
[code]config.json[/code]file is created on first run. Options:
[list]
[*] [b]OpenMenuKey[/b] (default: F6) — key to open the panel[/*]
[*][b]ShowMorningAlert[/b] (default: true) — notify on wake-up when items are ready[/*]
[*][b]ScanChests[/b] (default: true) — detect museum items in farm chests[/*]
[*][b]EnableTooltips[/b] (default: true) — show museum status on inventory tooltips[/*]
[*][b]ShowAcquisitionHints[/b] (default: false) — show how to obtain each item[/*]
[/list]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, you can change these settings in-game.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*] Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+ (required)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Source Code[/b]
[url=https://github.com/nullrootd/Stardew-Museum-Tip-PT-BR]GitHub repository[/url]
